memory_update.text: LEU should remain the primary underfollowed public candidate for the nuclear fuel-cycle node because it has direct HALEU/enrichment exposure and is much narrower than utilities, reactor developers, or diversified industrials.
CCJ is the reference public leader for uranium and fuel-services/conversion economics, useful as a benchmark even if less underfollowed.
BWXT is a public advanced-fuel and nuclear-fabrication candidate, but later layers must separate commercial advanced-reactor upside from defense/government baseline revenue.
US uranium conversion appears strategically important but may not have a clean public pure-play; Honeywell/ConverDyn is a key asset mapping but likely too diluted for clean equity exposure.

node: Nuclear fuel cycle: uranium, conversion, enrichment, HALEU, fabrication
summary: Layer 1B expansion found that the cleanest US-listed direct exposure remains sparse. Centrus is the most direct public HALEU/enrichment chokepoint candidate. Cameco is the large public uranium plus conversion/fuel-services reference leader. BWX Technologies is the public advanced nuclear fuel/fabrication and nuclear-components leader, but it is already well followed and less small-cap. Honeywell is included only as a context/reference name because its Metropolis/ConverDyn exposure appears strategically critical but financially diluted inside a mega-cap. The key coverage gap is that conversion may be one of the tightest bottlenecks, yet the investable pure-play public expression is weak or absent.
